pages.text: When a $(thing)The End ritual$() is completed within 10 blocks of an Ascension Cake, the cake is steeped in the aura of the End and becomes a The-End Cake.$(br)It is no longer a mere dessert to sate hunger, but a proof of divinity.
A The-End Cake still offers 3 slices, but only the $(thing)caster of the ritual$() may take from it.$(br)Anyone else who reaches for it will come away empty-handed.
